ኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, at; where (preposition / conjunction) · 'with, in the possession of' (ኢተርፈት ኀበ ኢዮርብዓም 'it did not remain with Jeroboam') · opening a title-like clause, 'how' or 'when' (ኀበ አስሐተቶ ለሰሎሞን ወለተ ፈርዖን 'how Pharaoh's daughter led Solomon astray') (?)
ለእሙ: እም — to his mother (ለ- + noun 'mother' + -ሁ '3ms his', giving እሙ)
አንገሥዎ: አንገሠ — they made him king (causative 3mp perf. with suffix 3ms -ዎ)
ወሶበ: ሶበ — and when (ወ- + conjunction) · and Sobo (ወ- + proper name ሶበ, in the list of lands ruled by the Ishmaelites, ወሶበ ወኵርጒ; unidentified) (?)
አርመሙ: አርመመ — they fell silent (3mp perfect, causative-type stem) (?)
ተንሥአ: ተንሥአ — he arose, rose up (3m sg perfect, n-s-ʾ)
ፍርሀተ: ፍርሀት — fear (construct 'fear of') · also accusative, object: ያአትት ፍርሀተ 'he removes fear'
እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · 'while', also 'though' in contrast (እንዘ ክቡር ስምነ 'though our name was honored')
ትርዕድ: ርዕደ — she trembles, it trembled (3fs imperfect, G, r-ʿ-d; subject ልብ 'heart')

ወኢኮነ: ኮነ — and was/is not (ወ- 'and' + ኢ- 'not' + 3ms perfect, G, k-w-n)
ወይነብር: ነበረ — and he dwells (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G)
ኢያአትት: አአተተ — he does not remove, put away (?) (ኢ- + 3ms imperfect; as ወያአትት in ch. 27, the stem is not well known) (?)
እምእለ: እለ — more than those who (እም- comparative + relative pronoun) · from among those who, of those who (እም- partitive; ፩ እምእለ ይቴሐቱ 'one of those who are humbled')
ትእዛዞ: ትእዛዝ — his command (noun + -ሁ '3ms his', anticipating ለእግዚኣብሔር 'the command of God') · his commandment, as a plain object with no owner named after it (ዐቀብከ ትእዛዞ 'you have kept his commandment')
ይሄሉ: ሀሎ — he will be, is present (3ms imperfect, h-l-w)
ወትረ: ወትር — always, continually (adverb, accusative; ወ- is part of the word)
ወይእዜኒአ: ይእዜ — and now (ወ- + adverb + enclitic -ኒ; stray final -አ, a spelling habit of this chapter)
ወደቂቀ: ደቂቅ — and sons of (ወ- 'and' + plural construct)
ኀያላነ: ኀያል — mighty ones (noun, plural ኀያላን, construct 'mighty ones of')
እስራኤል: እስራኤል — Israel (proper name; vocative) · dependent on a construct (ኀያላነ እስራኤል 'the mighty ones of Israel'; ch. 53) · also plain 'Israel', as subject or in ደቂቀ እስራኤል 'children of Israel' (ተሀየይዎ እስራኤል 'Israel ...', ch. 55–56)
በቅድመ: ቅድመ — before, in the presence of (በ- + preposition)

ኢለየማን: የማን — not to the right (ኢ- + ለ- + noun 'right hand, right')
ወኢለፀጋም: ፀጋም — and not to the left (ወ- + ኢ- + ለ- + noun 'left')
እምዘ: ዘ — from him who (እም- + relative pronoun) · 'beyond what' (እምዘ ኢተሐዘብኩ 'beyond what I had expected') · 'from what' (እምዘ ንኤዝዘከ 'from what we command you') · 'since' of time (እምዘ ኀለፉ 'since they passed')
ይቤሉነ: ይቤ — they said to us (3mp perfect ይቤሉ of the defective verb 'say' + -ነ '1cp to us')

ወከመ: ከመ — that, so that (conjunction; ወ- 'and') · and as (ወከመ ዝ 'and as this') · 'and like' before a noun (ወከመ ድምፀ አንበሳ 'and like the voice of a lion')
ዘቦቱ: በ — who has (ዘ- relative + preposition በ + -ቱ '3ms'; ቦቱ 'in him', expressing possession: 'he who has')
ወኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, at (preposition; ወ- 'and') · and where, and wherever (conjunction, ወኀበ ሖረ ይተልዎ 'and wherever he went it pursued him')
እዴሁ: እድ — his hand (noun + -ሁ '3ms his'; with suffix እዴ-)
ጽሑፍ: ጽሑፍ — written; a writing (passive participle, noun)
ውስቴቱ: ውስተ — within it, in it (preposition ውስተ, stem ውስቴ- + 3ms suffix -ቱ)
ለእለ: እለ — those who, who (plural relative pronoun; ለ- 'to, for')
ገብርዋ: ገብረ — they made it/her (root g-b-r, 3pl + obj) · they did it (ገብርዋ ለእኪት 'they did the evil')
ለእኪት: እኪት — evil (fem. adj./noun, ለ- marking object)
ወለእለ: እለ — and to those who (ወ- + ለ- + relative pronoun pl.)
ለሠናይት: ሠናይት — the good (noun, fem. of ሠናይ; ለ- marking the object after ይገብርዋ)
ኤልምያስ: ኤልምያስ — Elmeyas (proper name; named with Azariah as one of those who adjured them; his office is not given in this unit, and ወአልምያስ below is probably the same man) (?)
ወአዛርያስ: አዛርያስ — and Azariah (ወ- + proper name; the Azariah of the earlier parts; named here with Elmeyas, and the two offices ሊቀ ካህናት and ሊቀ ዲያቆናት are not assigned to the two men)
ይእቲ: ይእቲ — she/it is (fem. pron.) · 'I am she' predicate (አነ ይእቲ አቡከ 'I am she, your father') · 'that' (fem. demonstrative, ይእቲ ሠሉስ ዕለት 'that third day') · 'she' restating the subject, a resumptive pronoun before a noun (ይእቲ ባሕርይ 'she, the pearl')
መጽሐፈ: መጽሐፍ — a book (noun, accusative) · construct 'book of' (መጽሐፈ ሕግ 'the book of the law', ch. 55)
እንተ: እንተ — which, who (rel. pron. fem.) · in the phrase እንተ ባሕቲቱ 'privately, apart' (lit. 'which his solitude'; here the son is drawn aside alone) · fem. relative before a noun, ሐወጸ እንተ ታዕካ ቤተ መንግሥት 'looked out (?), which the ታዕካ of the palace'; the link to the verb is unclear (?) · 'which is' of the place (እንተ ኀበ ቊልፈትክሙ 'which is at your backside (?)') · 'whose' before a possessed noun (እንተ ስማ አቢስ 'whose name is Abishag') · እንተ የብስ 'which [is] dry land': the relative standing after a feminine noun, ባሕር (ትተረጐም, 3fs, shows it is feminine), 'the sea, which [became] dry land'; a prepositional 'by, on' is possible but less likely (?) · fem. relative or link before an adverb of place, 'who/which [was]' (ወሖረት እንተ ድኅሬሁ 'and she went [she] behind him'; ቆብዐ እንተ መትሕተ አክሊሉ 'a cap which [was] beneath his crown') · fem. relative before a verb, 'which' (እንተ ሄደ 'which went (?)') · 'by, along' before a place, perhaps prepositional (እንተ ፍኖተ አዝያባ 'by the road of Azyaba'; እንተ መሰስ 'by Mäsäs') (?)
ወበቅድመ: ቅድመ — and before (ወ- + በ- + preposition, with a following construct)
ንጉሠ: ንጉሥ — king (accusative) · also construct 'king of' (ንጉሠ ሮምሂ 'the king of Rome too') · predicate accusative 'as king' (ዘይከውን ንጉሠ 'who will be king'; ይኩነነ ንጉሠ 'may he be king for us')
መክዳ: ማክዳ — Makeda (proper name; spelled መክዳ, variant of ማክዳ)
ዐበይተ: ዐቢይ — great (adjective; plural ዐበይት, accusative form) · as a noun, 'great ones, notables' (construct, ዐበይተ እስራኤል 'notables of Israel')

ኵሎሙ: ኵሉ — all of them (+ -omu) · before a noun, 'all' (ኵሎሙ አድያመ ኢትዮጵያ 'all the regions of Ethiopia', ch. 55)
ወገነዩ: ገነየ — and they did homage, served (ወ- + 3mp perfect)
ለዘ: ዘ — he who, that which (relative pronoun; ለ- 'to')
ቃለ: ቃል — word (construct 'word of') · accusative 'a word' (ዘንተ ቃለ 'this word') · 'voice of' in the title ቃለ ታዕካ (?)
ወወሀቦሙ: ወሀበ — and he gave them (ወ- + 3m sg perfect + -omu, w-h-b)
ፍትሐ: ፍትሕ — judgment, justice (noun, accusative) · construct 'judgment of' (ፍትሐ ሕዝበ አምላከ እስራኤል 'judgment of the people of the God of Israel')
ወኵነኔሁ: ኵነኔ — and his judgment (ወ- + noun + -ሁ '3ms his')
ወዓዲ: ዓዲ — and still, also, moreover (ወ- + adverb)
ሰብአ: ሰብእ — man (accusative) · construct 'men of' (ሰብአ ቤቱ 'men of his house')
ሀለወት: ሀለወ — she was, she was present (3fs perfect, h-l-w)
ማእከሌሆሙ: ማእከል — between them (noun 'middle' + -ሆሙ '3mp their'; ማእከሌሆሙ 'among them, between them')
ወማኅደረ: ማኅደር — and dwelling-place of (ወ- + noun, construct)
እምኵሉ: ኵሉ — out of all, from all (እም- 'from' + ኵሉ)
እንስሳሆሙ: እንስሳ — their livestock, flocks (collective noun + -ሆሙ '3mp their')
ወተዐቅብ: ዐቀበ — and she keeps, guards (ወ- + 3fs imperfect, ʿ-ḳ-b)
ፍጽመ: ፍጽም — completeness, wholeness (noun, accusative, predicate after ይኩንከ)
ወኳላ: ኳላ — unidentified word (?) (ወ- + noun or other; not found) (?)
ኵሉ: ኵሉ — all, every, the whole of · 'everyone', used alone (ያፈቅር ኵሉ 'everyone loves') · ወበዝ ኵሉ 'and in all this'
ሖሩ: ሖረ — they went (3mp perfect, ḥ-w-r) · go! (2mp imperative, ሖሩ በመንፈስ 'go in the spirit')
ወተፈሥሑ: ተፈሥሐ — and they rejoiced (ወ- + 3mp perfect, tä-stem)
ወንግሥትኒ: ንግሥት — and the queen too (ወ- + noun, fem. + emphatic -ኒ)
ትቤሎ: ብህለ — you said to him (2ms perfect ትቤ, the same form as 3fs; defective verb b-h-l, + -ሎ '3ms to him') · she said to him (3fs ትቤ + -ሎ '3ms to him', Sarah to Abraham)
ለወልዳ: ወልድ — her son (ለ- marking the object + noun + -ኣ '3fs her')
ወሀበከ: ወሀበ — he gave you (3ms perfect, G + -ከ 'you', 2ms)
ርትዐ: ርትዕ — what is right, righteousness (noun, accusative)
ወኢትትገሐሥ: ተገሐሠ — and do not turn aside (ወ- + ኢ- + 2ms imperfect/jussive, tG-stem, g-ḥ-ś) (?)
መሓሪ: መሓሪ — merciful (active participle, agent noun of ምሕረ, m-ḥ-r)
ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he, it (3ms independent pronoun; also serves as copula 'is')
ለየዋሃን: የዋህ — to the gentle (ለ- + plural የዋሃን, used as a noun)
ፍኖቱ: ፍኖት — his road, way (noun, fem. + -ሁ '3ms his')
ነገሩ: ነገር — his speech, word, matter (noun + -ሁ '3ms his')
ኀቤሆሙ: ኀበ — to them (preposition ኀበ, stem ኀቤ- + -ሆሙ '3mp')
ለመንግሥተ: መንግሥት — of/for the kingdom of (ለ- + noun, construct; ለ- marking the doubled object)
ለጽዮን: ጽዮን — of/for Zion · marking the object, doubled by the suffix on the verb (አንሥእዋ ለጽዮን 'they raised Zion') · naming the owner after a suffix (ምንባሪሃ ለጽዮን 'the seat of Zion'; እምላዕሌሃ ለጽዮን 'from upon Zion', ch. 56)
ወለኵሉ: ኵሉ — and to all, for all (ወ- + ለ- + ኵሉ)
በአስተጠናቅቆ: አስተጠናቀቀ — with care (በ- + verbal noun in -ኦ, cf. ተሀውኮ; ṭ-n-q-q) (?)
ለዓለም: ዓለም — for ever (ለ- 'to, for' + noun 'age, world, eternity') · 'of the world', the owner after an anticipating suffix (ብርሃኖ ለዓለም 'the light of the world') · 'for ever' also after ካህኑ: 'his priest for ever', or 'priest of the world' (?)

ይኅድር: ኀደረ — he may dwell (3ms subjunctive, G, ḫ-d-r)
ወአንተኒ: አንተ — and you also (ወ- 'and' + 2ms independent pronoun + enclitic -ኒ 'also')

በምክሮሙ: ምክር — by their counsel (በ- 'by' + noun + -ሙ '3mp their')

ንዋየ: ንዋይ — goods, vessels, possessions (construct 'goods of') · accusative 'goods' (ወኵሎ ንዋየ ወሀበት 'and all goods she gave')

ወበጽዮን: ጽዮን — and by Zion (ወ- 'and' + በ- 'by' + proper name)
ታቦተ: ታቦት — ark, tabernacle (construct 'ark of') · also accusative 'an ark' (ግበር ታቦተ 'make an ark')
ወይግረሩ: ገረረ — and may they bow down, yield (ወ- + 3mp jussive; root and meaning inferred from context) (?)
ዘቅሩብ: ቅሩብ — which is near (ዘ- relative + adjective ቅሩብ 'near', masc. sg.)
ደቂቀ: ደቂቅ — sons, children (plural ደቂቅ, construct 'sons of')
ኀይል: ኀይል — strength, might (noun; construct ደቂቀ ኀይል 'sons of strength', i.e. the mighty)
አውሥኡ: አውሥአ — they answered (causative 3mp perfect, from ወሥአ)
ወይቤሉ: ብህለ — and they said (ወ- 'and' + 3mp perfect ይቤሉ of b-h-l)
ይከውኖ: ኮነ — be, become (3ms imperfect + -ሁ 'to him', 3ms, form -o)
ወነገረ: ነገር — and the affairs of (ወ- + noun, construct 'word, matter of'; the spelling is also that of a verb 'and he said') (?)
እሙ: እም — his mother (noun + -ሁ '3ms his', contracted እሙ) · 'its mother' of an animal (ጽጉበ ሐሊበ እሙ 'sated with its mother's milk'; ch. 53)
ይሰምዕ: ሰምዐ — he hears, listens (3ms imperfect, G, s-m-ʿ; ኵሉ ሕዝብ ይሰምዕ 'all the people listened')
ወንንግሮ: ነገረ — and let us tell him (ወ- + 1cp jussive + -ኦ 'him', G)
ሠናይ: ሠናይ — good, beautiful (adj.) · 'good' as a substantive (ዘይረክበከ ሠናይ 'what good will find you')
አልቦ: አልቦ — there is not, none (negative existential) · 'no, not so' as a reply (አልቦ እግዚኦ 'No, O lord', ch. 56)
ዘእንበለ: ዘእንበለ — without, except (preposition) · conjunction 'without' + jussive (ዘእንበለ ይስቅይዋ 'without their watering her') · conjunction + perfect 'without (its having been done)' (ዘእንበለ ተሀበኒ ትእምርተ 'without a sign having been given me') · 'except' (ዘእንበለ ዘተሐምም 'except what she suffered') · conjunction 'before' + subjunctive (ዘእንበለ ይስአሉ አበዊነ ንጉሠ 'before our fathers asked for a king') (?)
በከመ: ከመ — as, in the way that (በ- 'in' + ከመ)
ዘጽዑን: ጸዐነ — laden, loaded (ዘ- relative + passive participle ጽዑን of ጸዐነ 'load')
ባዕድ: ባዕድ — another, a stranger (adjective/noun; ብእሲተ ባዕድ 'another man's wife') · 'strange, foreign' (አማልክተ ባዕድ 'strange gods')
ሞትነ: ሞት — our death (noun + -ነ '1cp our') · also ሞተ — we die, we died (1cp perfect, G, used as a conditional: እመሂ ሞትነ 'whether we die', እመኒ ሞትነ 'even if we die'; m-w-t)
ሐየውነ: ሐየወ — we live (1cp perfect used as a conditional, G, ḥ-y-w)
ብሔረ: ብሔር — land, region (construct 'land of') · accusative 'a land' (ርሑቀ ብሔረ 'far, a land'; the construct reading is the alternative (?))
ኀቤክሙ: ኀበ — to you (preposition, stem ኀቤ- + -ክሙ '2mp you')
ማኅደረ: ማኅደር — dwelling-place (construct) · accusative 'a lodging' (ወወሀባ ማኅደረ 'and he gave her a lodging')
